title: Researchers in Michigan Aim to Grow Stronger Apple Trees
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Researchers in the U.S. state of Michigan are looking for ways to help apple trees survive bad weather.
sentences.zh: 美国密歇根州的研究人员 正在寻找办法 帮助苹果树度过恶劣的天气

sentences.en: To do this, one researcher plans to use a late bloomer .
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点,一个研究人员计划使用一个晚开花机。

sentences.en: The late blooming tree is a native Michigan apple tree known by the scientific name Malus coronaria .
sentences.zh: 最近开花的树是密歇根州的一棵本地苹果树,

sentences.en: To fight freezing temperatures, the tree blooms two or three weeks later than trees that produce cultivated varieties of apples like Honeycrisp or Red Delicious.
sentences.zh: 为了对抗寒冷的温度,树木在两三个星期后开花,比生产蜂蜜或红酒等养殖苹果品种的树木要晚两三个星期。

sentences.en: “That doesn’t sound like a lot, but almost always that’s enough for the flowers to escape the killing spring frost ,” said Steve van Nocker.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·范诺克(Steve van Nocker)说:「这听起来并不多,

sentences.en: He is a professor and plant geneticist at Michigan State University.
sentences.zh: 他是密歇根州立大学的教授和植物遗传学家。

sentences.en: Van Nocker wants to identify the genes responsible for the Malus coronaria’s delayed blooms.
sentences.zh: Van Nocker想确认导致马路氏冠状腺延后开花的基因。

sentences.en: Then he will use those genes to develop more frost-resistant apple varieties.
sentences.zh: 然后他将利用这些基因 开发更耐冻的苹果品种。

sentences.en: Van Nocker’s project is one of many ways researchers and growers are trying to make apples more resilient.
sentences.zh: Van Nocker的项目是研究者和种植者试图使苹果更具复原力的许多方法之一。

sentences.en: They say this is important because of climate change.
sentences.zh: 他们说,由于气候变化,这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Other researchers are making similar efforts.
sentences.zh: 其他研究人员也在作出类似的努力。

sentences.en: Jared Buono is the director of Cornell University’s Hudson Valley Research Laboratory in New York state.
sentences.zh: Jared Buono是康奈尔大学纽约州哈德逊河谷研究实验室的主任。

sentences.en: Buono’s lab is adding solar panels to its experimental orchard .
sentences.zh: Buono的实验室正在实验果园中添加太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: He said growers are experimenting with solar panels in Europe and South Korea.
sentences.zh: 他说种植者正在欧洲和韩国试验太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: The panels protect fruit from hail and sun damage but also let in light and heat when necessary.
sentences.zh: 电池板保护水果免受冰雹和太阳的破坏,但也在必要时让灯光和热能进入。

sentences.en: University of Maryland researchers recently announced the development of a more heat- tolerant apple variety.
sentences.zh: 马里兰大学研究人员最近宣布开发一种更耐热的苹果品种。

sentences.en: At Penn State University in Pennsylvania, a team built an unmanned vehicle that uses propane fuel to warm trees up as it moves around an orchard.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州的宾夕法尼亚州立大学,一队人造车辆使用丙烷燃料在果园周围移动时温暖树木。

sentences.en: Buono said these efforts can ease the effects of bad weather.
sentences.zh: Buono说,这些努力可以减轻恶劣天气的影响。

sentences.en: On May 18, 2023, frost damaged trees across New York state and cut apple production by 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 2023年5月18日 霜冻破坏了纽约州的树木 苹果产量减少了20%

sentences.en: A recent Washington State University study examined weather in apple growing areas from 1979 to 2022.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州立大学最近的一项研究审查了1979年至2022年苹果生长区的天气。

sentences.en: It said the top apple producing states of Washington, Michigan and New York reported fewer cold days and more warm fall nights than they used to.
sentences.zh: 它说最大的苹果生产州 华盛顿,密歇根州和纽约 报告说寒冷的日子减少 和更多的温暖的秋天 比他们以前。

sentences.en: Washington state also has reported more extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州也报告 更极端的热量。

sentences.en: The study said warming temperatures could cause trees to come out of dormancy too early and increase the risk of sunburn.
sentences.zh: 研究指出,温度升高可能会使树木过早离开宿舍,增加晒太阳的风险。

sentences.en: This hurts the quality of apples. Malus coronaria is also called sweet crabapple.
sentences.zh: 这伤害了苹果的质量。麦氏冠状腺也叫甜蟹头。

sentences.en: It was once so common in Michigan that its blossoms were named the state flower in 1897.
sentences.zh: 它曾经在密歇根非常普遍 其花朵被命名为1897年的国家花朵。

sentences.en: But, van Nocker said it appears to be disappearing.
sentences.zh: 但是,范诺克说它似乎正在消失。

sentences.en: The trees that remain often produce little new growth or fruit.
sentences.zh: 留下的树木往往鲜有新的生长或水果。

sentences.en: Van Nocker and graduate student Lily Christian recently took cuttings from some trees.
sentences.zh: Van Nocker和研究生Lily Christian最近从树上砍了几根树

sentences.en: They will test them to make sure they are fully Malus coronaria and not a hybrid variety.
sentences.zh: 他们将测试他们 以确保他们完全马鲁斯冠状, 而不是混合品种。

sentences.en: Then, the cuttings will be grafted onto apple rootstock .
sentences.zh: 然后,切割 将连接到苹果根托克。

sentences.en: They hope to get healthy trees using this method.
sentences.zh: 他们希望使用这种方法获得健康的树木。

sentences.en: Their goal is to identify the genes that cause late blooming and create a variety of apple that can be sold in markets.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是找出导致晚产的基因,并创造各种可以在市场上销售的苹果。

sentences.en: Van Nocker is also sending seeds to the U.S.
sentences.zh: Van Nocker也在向美国发送种子

sentences.en: Department of Agriculture. If the tree continues to disappear, he hopes to save its genes this way.
sentences.zh: 农业部,如果这棵树继续消失,他希望这样保存它的基因。

sentences.en: Making a later-blooming commercial apple could take more than 10 years.
sentences.zh: 制作一个后爆的商用苹果 可能需要10年以上的时间。

sentences.en: If a Malus coronaria is crossbred with a commercial apple tree to make a new hybrid, it would take four or five years for that tree to start producing apples.
sentences.zh: 如果麦路斯的冠状腺 与商业苹果树交叉 制造一个新的混合体, 那要花四到五年时间 才能开始生产苹果。

sentences.en: Crossbreeding would continue until researchers developed an apple with the desired qualities of both varieties.
sentences.zh: 跨血会一直持续到研究人员开发出一个具有两种品种所需品质的苹果。

sentences.en: But van Nocker said it is important to try.
sentences.zh: 但范诺克说必须尝试

sentences.en: “With climate change, it’s quite possible that apples won’t be able to be produced in Michigan in the future,” he said. “That’s why cultivar improvement, especially in terms of frost resistance, is so important.”
sentences.zh: 他说 : “ 随着气候变化,苹果在未来可能无法在密歇根生产。 ”他说 : “ 这就是为什么种植业的改善,特别是冷冻抗药性,如此重要。 ”

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Dee-Ann Durbin reported this story for the Associated Press from Washington.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, Dee-Ann Durbin在华盛顿为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
